missables: Missables: 2 possible · 5 unknown triggers · 0 confirmed (PowerPyx: 1 potentially missable)
summary: One playthrough, no mission replay and no New Game Plus; free roam stays open after the credits.

stages.title: Chapter 1
stages.goal: Opening mission, Cal's fishing, an arcade game, and the meditation at Jason's house.
stages.why: The Jason's-house meditation spot only exists in Chapter 1, so it comes first.
tips: Do the Chapter 1 meditation before the chapter ends and keep a save from this chapter.
Cal's fishing questline opens after Feng Shui; an arcade game can be finished at home.

stages.title: Chapter 2
stages.goal: Breakfast Run, then the side work Coffee Break opens: Billy, Bret, the gym, partner heat.
stages.why: Coffee Break unlocks partner play and most side strands; garages and Scooter Bros open here too.
tips: Little Boxes opens after Daily Driver and On the Spot after Moses.
The bowling alley robbery respawns, so it is safe to leave for later.

stages.title: Chapter 3
stages.goal: The Cartel Heist, the jewelry jobs, laundering and four side finales.
stages.why: The Snap Gun and the Dye Pack Jammer arrive here, and Race Against Yago is time-sensitive.
tips: Play Race Against Yago before Chapter 3 ends.
Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner while you are in north Vice City.

stages.title: Chapters 4-5 & finale
stages.goal: The rest of the story plus the optional bank mission that opens vaults and armored trucks.
stages.why: Vault and armored-truck robberies unlock with an optional Chapter 4 mission.
tips: Make a manual save before the final mission: missions cannot be replayed.
Hot Together often pops during the vault jobs.

stages.title: Activities & strands
stages.goal: Stunts, ranges, drone races, races, challenges and the eight stranger strands.
stages.why: PowerPyx leaves activities and Strangers & Freaks for after the story.
tips: Fly under bridges for the quickest stunts.
Only some strangers count toward the eight strands.

stages.title: Collectibles, money & secrets
stages.goal: Cards, WAiNK scans, vehicles, map fog, gang jobs, spending, five secret triggers.
stages.why: Everything here stays open in free roam; five triggers are still unknown.
tips: A WAiNK scan also counts as discovering a vehicle.
Check back on the unknown triggers as the guides update.

stages.title: 100% and the platinum
stages.goal: Finish the 100% checklist under Progress > Stats, then the platinum follows.
stages.why: The checklist only appears after the credits, but earlier progress counts.
tips: Nothing on the 100% checklist can be missed, per PowerPyx.
Expect around 100 hours for this step.
